column1: # Black/Matrix AD - English script: Chapter 1 arrest scene / Zero route

column2: Oh my! It seems the troublesome $$奴隷$$ has returned!?
H-He... Let go of his hand!!
We don't wish to get rough with someone with black $$羽$$ like yourself, either!
But... if you insist on not treating the $$奴隷$$ like a $$奴隷$$...
if you continue to let him roam free without even a $$首輪$$...
then he will have to die!!
First of all, the rumors we hear say that even if you $$猫っ可愛がり$$ a $$奴隷$$ as a $$ペット$$,
putting clothes on him is rather excessive, don't you think!?
T-This guy... isn't like that!!
Well, it's your right to form an $$執着心$$ to your own $$奴隷$$, but!
I see!!
Is it like when a cup you didn't like when someone gave it to you,
starts to seem like a good one after using it every day, that sort of thing!?
I-I think of this guy as an irreplaceable friend... L-$$愛$$...
Ah!!
$$愛$$, you say~!
That is what is commonly called “$$恋$$” in this $$世界$$, a human's misunderstanding while in $$発情期$$!
(Damn it...!!)
When any animal enters $$発情期$$, their heart races, and the $$血$$ rushes to their head...
and sometimes they start shouting things that make no sense.
Then, in that case, you should simply do with him as you please!!
Don't be ashamed of having $$欲情$$ed after a $$奴隷$$!
To $$欲情$$ after someone...
is, for every animal, a fundamental act tied to preserving the $$種族$$!
First of all, to speak of something like...
something called $$愛$$—a fantasy that does not actually exist in $$この世$$—
don't you know that is one of the $$七つの大罪$$!?
